subject: [PATCH v2 3/8] SUNRPC: keep the first error in svc_register()

2026-08-11.patch_summary: This patch modifies the svc_register() function in the SUNRPC code to keep track of the first error encountered during program registration, rather than overwriting it with subsequent errors. This change is necessary because the previous behavior would cause a server to fail to bring up any listener if it had multiple versions enabled and one version failed to register. The patch fixes this issue by keeping the first error encountered and returning it as the final result.
